statement: Let n = len(nums). For a subset T of {0,...,n-1}, let S(T) = Σ_{i=0}^{n-1} ((nums[i] XOR k) if i ∈ T else nums[i]). The function returns a result r such that r = max { S(T) : T ⊆ {0,...,n-1} and |T| is even }. The empty set T=∅ is allowed, so this is a nonempty finite maximum.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The inputs satisfy: 2 <= n <= 20000; 1 <= k <= 1000000000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000; len(edges) = n - 1; every entry of edges is a pair [a,b] with 0 <= a,b < n; and the undirected graph with vertices 0,...,n-1 and these edges is a tree.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = Σ_{i=0}^{n-1} nums[i] + Σ_{i : g_i > 0} g_i.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The inputs satisfy: 2 <= n <= 20000; 1 <= k <= 1000000000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000; len(edges) = n - 1; every entry of edges is a pair [a,b] with 0 <= a,b < n; and the undirected graph with vertices 0,...,n-1 and these edges is a tree. Also let g_i = (nums[i] XOR k) - nums[i] for 0 <= i < n; the number of indices i with g_i > 0 is even.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, the following holds. Let P = { i : 0 <= i < n and g_i > 0 } and N = { i : 0 <= i < n and g_i <= 0 }. P is nonempty. Let m = min_{i∈P} g_i. If N is empty, then r = Σ_{i=0}^{n-1} nums[i] + Σ_{i∈P} g_i - m. If N is nonempty, let M = max_{i∈N} g_i; then r = Σ_{i=0}^{n-1} nums[i] + Σ_{i∈P} g_i + max(-m, M).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). Also let g_i = (nums[i] XOR k) - nums[i] for 0 <= i < n; the number of indices i with g_i > 0 is odd.

statement: Whenever maximum_value_sum nums k edges returns r and maximum_value_sum nums k e2 returns r2, we have r = r2.

statement: Whenever maximum_value_sum nums k edges returns r and maximum_value_sum nums2 k e2 returns r2, we have r = r2.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = Σ_{i=0}^{n-1} nums[i] if and only if for every subset T of {0,...,n-1} with |T| even, Σ_{i∈T} ((nums[i] XOR k) - nums[i]) <= 0.

statement: Let g_i = (nums[i] XOR k) - nums[i] for 0 <= i < n, and let P = {i : 0 <= i < n and g_i > 0}. Whenever the function returns a result r, if |P| is even then r = Σ_{i=0}^{n-1} max(nums[i], nums[i] XOR k); if |P| is odd then r = Σ_{i=0}^{n-1} max(nums[i], nums[i] XOR k) - min_{0 <= i < n} |g_i|.
